name: pet_atlas_repair_internal_alpha_holes
notes: Swiss-cheese alpha repair for generated sprites. REAL src/pet/atlas.c::pet_repair_internal_alpha_holes linked via extra_src against LIVE _repair_internal_alpha_holes (PIL-backed). PORT FIX APPLIED: the C border-seed loops used `y += (h-1)`, which spins forever when h==1 or w==1 — replaced with explicit two-row/col iteration mirroring LIVE. AGREED SUB-CONTRACT: inputs keep the opaque surroundings uniform so the hole-fill colour average is exact — C truncates the integer mean while LIVE uses round() (banker's), so fractional averages would diverge. B1 guards malformed/dimension-mismatched input; B2 fires when at least one transparent pixel became an opaque fill.
